product.name: VectorShift Platform
product.description: A platform combining no-code interface and code SDK to build, deploy, and manage AI applications and workflows.

product.name: AI Chatbots
product.description: Customizable AI chatbots designed for customer-facing interactions, integrated with organizational data and response guidelines.

product.name: Workflow Automation
product.description: Automates creation of marketing copy, personalized emails, call summaries, and graphics at scale.

product.name: Knowledge Bases and Search
product.description: Tools to create and query knowledge bases from documents and databases for AI-powered information retrieval.

product.name: AI Agents
product.description: Configurable autonomous AI agents that execute complex tasks by decomposing and completing subtasks.

product.name: Integrations and Automations
product.description: Connects and automates workflows across popular apps like Google Drive, Hubspot, Slack, Gmail, Notion, and Airtable.
